auth_recovery_error: We couldn’t verify your sign-in. Your token is saved. Check your connection and retry, or sign out to browse without an account.
auth_recovery_storage: We couldn’t access saved sign-in data. Allow browser storage, then retry or sign out.
auth_recovery_deleted_storage: Your account was deleted from the server, but local recovery cleanup could not finish. Allow browser storage and retry local cleanup below. This does not contact the server or delete another account's drafts.
teaching_unavailable: Teaching content is unavailable for this earlier cook.
source_unknown: Original source content unknown. Start a new attempt with today’s recipe, or record the earlier cook without a snapshot.
snapshot_load_error: We couldn’t load this cook. Retry to keep the same attempt.
reflection_conflict: This reflection changed elsewhere. Review the latest values below before saving a new correction.
reflection_ambiguous: Your save may have reached the server. Retry safely, or continue without further changes.
confidence_current_hint: Choose the support you want now. This does not change what you recorded for earlier cooks.
auth_switch_to_login: Already have an account? Log in
api_password_too_short: Password must be at least {n} characters
instructions: Instructions — tap a step when done
cook_timer_clock_changed: The device clock changed. Timer paused at the last reliable remaining time. Check before resuming.
cook_timer_storage_read: Saved timer could not be read. Restore browser storage and retry before starting another timer.
cook_timer_storage_write: Timer changes are only on this screen, not saved. Restore browser storage and retry before leaving.
cook_timer_corrupt: Saved timer is invalid and has been left untouched. Retry reading it or explicitly reset only the timer.
cook_timer_changed: This attempt's timer changed elsewhere. Retry to load it before making further timer changes.
cook_timer_missing: This attempt's saved timer record is unavailable. Timer storage has not been changed.
cook_timer_finished: This cook has already been finished. Its timer is stopped.
cook_timer_coordination: Timer changes are blocked: another tab is saving, or this browser cannot coordinate timer storage. Use a supported browser or retry after the other tab finishes. You can keep cooking.
cook_timer_background: Time is checked when you return. Clock changes may be undetectable after reload. No guaranteed background or locked-screen alarm. Finishing this cook ends the timer.
cook_wakelock_active: Keeping the screen awake while cooking.
cook_wakelock_unavailable: Screen awake protection is unavailable. Your screen may lock.
cook_wakelock_denied: Screen awake request declined. Your screen may lock.
cook_wakelock_released: Screen awake protection ended. Your screen may lock.
list_add_needs_household: You need a shared grocery list first.
list_add_needs_account: Create an account to build a shopping list.
list_add_failed: Couldn't add to the list — try again.
locked_desc_account: Create a free account to unlock this tier.
locked_desc_premium: Upgrade to Premium to unlock this tier.
premium_coming_soon: Premium plans aren't available yet — check back soon.
household_setup_sub: Start a shared list, or join one someone already started.
household_invalid_code: That code doesn't match a household
grocery_invite_hint: Share this code so someone else can join
grocery_empty: Nothing on the list yet — add a recipe or an item below.
planner_build_list: Add week's plan to grocery list
progress_empty: Cook a dish to start tracking your progress.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings_export_desc: Download your saved account records as JSON: profile, favourites, cooking history and reflections, confidence, preferences, private plans, events, shopping and templates, plus retained legacy records.
settings_delete_desc: Permanently deletes your account and its private planning, shopping, preferences and cooking records. Shared legacy household items remain for other members without your account attribution; an empty household is deleted.
settings_delete_confirm: This can't be undone. Delete your account permanently?
privacy_body_1: Your account stores your email, password hash and display name. Saved preferences, favourites, private plans, events, shopping lists, templates and cooking history are held by the backend. Reflection and confidence answers are optional. New private plans are not shared with other accounts. The separate legacy household features share their lists with household members.
privacy_body_2: Settings provides account export and deletion. Active cooking attempts, guest preferences and recovery information for unfinished saves also use this browser's storage. They are not a live cross-device cooking session. Deleting an account removes its private records; shared legacy household data has separate handling described in Settings.
privacy_draft: Local development summary — not the final public privacy notice. Operator contact, service providers, retention periods and recovery/deletion procedures still need approval before launch.
meal_plans_empty: No meal plans yet — bundle a few recipes and share the link.
meal_plan_delete_confirm: Delete this meal plan? The share link will stop working.
meal_plan_not_found: This meal plan link doesn't work anymore
meal_plan_not_found_sub: It may have been deleted, or the link is incorrect.
reflect_confidence_title: How confident do you feel with this?
guest_cook_done_hint: Create an account to save your cooking history and reflect on what you practiced.
settings_delete_busy: Another tab is saving. Wait for it to finish, then retry deletion.
settings_delete_browser: This browser cannot safely coordinate deletion with other tabs. Use a supported current browser; no deletion was sent.
settings_delete_storage: Browser storage could not protect this operation. Restore storage access and retry. Deletion has not been confirmed.
settings_delete_unconfirmed: Deletion has not been confirmed. Check your connection and retry deletion. Planning may stay paused while an earlier request is unresolved; signing in again does not prove whether it completed.
api_needs_account: Create a free account to use this tier.
